formative_worksheets.title: Mid-Unit Equality Check-In
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. A 10-minute check on C2.2.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can decide if two expressions are equal and find a missing number.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can decide if two expressions are equal and find a missing number.
header.character_watermark: Bella in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

image_placeholders.description: Six expression-pair rows in B&W. Pairs include both equal and not-equal cases.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q1_PAIRS: keywords (pair, equal) name what the rows ask for.

prompts.answer_key: Mix of = and ≠ depending on the pairs.

prompts.prompt: Find the missing number in each equation.

image_placeholders.description: Six missing-number equations in B&W. Mix of addition and subtraction.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q2_MISSING: keywords (missing, number) name what the equations ask for.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle the face.
prompts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Three faces in a row. Below each: 'GOT IT!', 'ALMOST!', 'TRY AGAIN!'.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons in a row. Smile, neutral, frown.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image FORM_Q3_FACES: keywords (got, almost, try) name the labels.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Score: 6/6 pairs correct + 6/6 missing numbers = ready for Lesson 4. Below = small-group reteach.

reflection_sheet.title: My Balance Stories Reflection
reflection_sheet.student_learning_goal: I can think about what I learned this week.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can think about what I learned this week.
header.character_watermark: Bella with a Junior certificate. Small (~1.5in tall).

prompts.prompt: How do you feel about being a Junior Balance Beam Scientist? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three rating ovals in B&W. 1 star, 2 stars, 3 stars. Labels: 'Just starting', 'Mostly got it', 'I am a Balance Scientist!'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_STARS: keywords (stars) name the rating ovals.

prompts.prompt: Did you do these things? Circle YES or NO.

image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_YN_TABLE: keywords (yes, no) name the response bubbles.

prompts.prompt: Which was your FAVOURITE part of the unit?
prompts.visual_layout: Four icon options in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Four icons in B&W: sorting cards, balance scale, missing numbers, story writing. Each ~1in × 1in with selection bubble.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_FAV_BOX: keywords (icons) name the four options.

prompts.visual_layout: Three tricky-moment cards in a row.

image_placeholders.description: Three tricky-moment cards in a row in B&W. Card A: snapshot vs trend (children in class). Card B: equal sign as 'gives the answer'. Card C: writing the missing number. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_TRICKY_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

prompts.prompt: What do you want to learn NEXT?

image_placeholders.description: Three forward-goal cards in a row in B&W. Each ~1.5in × 1.5in.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image REF_NEXT_BOX: keywords (cards) name the three cards.

reflection_sheet.teacher_notes: Hand out at end of Lesson 5.
